svg.title: Kiel diagram of the 187 Ariel host stars of Magrini et al. 2022
svg.desc: Surface gravity against effective temperature for the 187 F, G and K planet hosts of table A.1, each with its error bars, sized by mass and shaded by iron abundance. Filled marks are thin-disc stars and open marks thick-disc stars by the paper's peculiar-velocity rule: 146 thin disc, 16 thick disc, 24 in between and one without an orbit. The main sequence runs from the hot, low-gravity corner at the upper left to the cool, high-gravity corner at the lower right, with the Sun marked for reference.
